q: Which board is the school affiliated with?
a: TVV follows the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education up to Class X, and the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education for Class XI–XII, across both Science and Arts streams.

q: What is the admission process and when does it open?
a: Admissions generally open ahead of the new academic session. The process has three steps — collecting the prospectus, submitting the application with prior mark-sheets, and a short admissions interview. Contact the school office for exact current dates.

q: Is transport available for students outside Tufanganj town?
a: Many students commute from surrounding areas independently or via local transport; the school itself does not currently run dedicated buses. Please check with the office for the latest arrangement.

q: Can a student switch between Science and Arts after Class X?
a: Stream choice is made at the start of Class XI based on the student's Class X performance and interest. Switching after that point is discouraged but can be discussed with the class teacher and Principal on a case-by-case basis.

q: How does the school communicate with parents day-to-day?
a: Through the physical Notice Board, scheduled Parent-Teacher Meetings, and the digital Notice Board on this site and in the Smart Portal.

q: What safety measures are in place on campus?
a: The campus gate is supervised during school hours, teachers are present through every break period, and each class has a designated teacher-in-charge as a direct point of contact for parents.

q: What is the full name of the school?
a: The full name is Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.) — the “H.S.” stands for Higher Secondary. It is also written Tufanganj Vivekanand Vidyalaya, and many people simply say TVV. In Bengali the name is তুফানগঞ্জ বিবেকানন্দ বিদ্যালয়।

q: Where is Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya located?
a: The school is in Tufanganj, Cooch Behar district, West Bengal, India. The Contact page shows the school on a map and has a message form for the school office.

q: Which classes does the school teach?
a: Class V to Class XII. From Class XI students choose the Science or the Arts stream.
Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.) was established in 1964 and is named after Swami Vivekananda.

q: Which board examinations do students take?
a: Class X students take the Madhyamik examination of the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education, and Class XII students take the Higher Secondary examination of the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education.

q: How do I apply for admission, for example to Class XI?
a: Use the admission enquiry form on the Admissions page: enter the student's name, the guardian's contact number and the class you are applying for, and the school office will contact you. Forms and other documents are listed on the Downloads page.

q: Where can I read the school's notices?
a: On the Notices page of this website. Every notice has its own link that you can share, and new notices appear as soon as the school office publishes them.

q: Where can I see results and achievements?
a: The Results & Achievements page lists the results, awards and recognition that the school office has published. Students see their own marks, marksheets and attendance after they log in to the student portal.
Yes. The TVV School app for Android is on the App page of this website: timetable, homework, projects, attendance and results on your phone.

q: How do students and teachers log in to the portal?
a: Accounts are created by the school office — there is no public sign-up. Use Student & Staff Login on this website with the username and password the school gave you.

q: How do I contact the school office?
a: Send a message from the Contact page. For admissions use the admission enquiry form instead. The office replies using the phone number or email address you give.
